purpose: Authorize the adopted in-match recent public Battle history presentation over the existing replay consumer without creating a second event/log authority.
goal: Keep the newest viewer-authorized public Battle events immediately readable in the existing Battle log and allow older public rows to be revealed inline without leaving Battle.
keepReason: Current replay adapter already owns a viewer-safe canonical public event projection and existing battleLog consumer; a presentation-only compact/reveal layer closes a player comprehension gap without duplicating replay state.
changeReason: The adopted Battle recent-history gate is not yet implemented at the actual consumer use-site: rows accumulate, but there is no explicit compact-current versus inline-history presentation state.
dropReason: Delete this authorization after the product patch and focused regression pass; it is evidence for the write gate, not runtime data.
acceptanceNow: One canonical public replay projection only; newest public rows remain immediately readable; older rows are inline-revealable; begin/reset collapses presentation cleanly; duplicate/stale projection does not duplicate rows; presentation failure never blocks replay/gameplay; no secret/private fields or gameplay write are introduced.
nonAdoptionBoundary: No second recorder, replay state, event schema, persistence or storage
No secret/private information expansion or post-hoc hidden knowledge
No gameplay, save, economy, network, spectator-follow or shared GAMEROAD.html mutation
Do not freeze a permanent exact visible-row count, dimensions or player-facing wording before actual UI/Human acceptance
